title: One-dimensional Japanese Crossword
statementMd:
Recently Adaltik discovered japanese crosswords. Japanese crossword is a picture, represented as a table sized $*a* × *b*$ squares, and each square is colored white or black. There are integers to the left of the rows and to the top of the columns, encrypting the corresponding row or column. The number of integers represents how many groups of black squares there are in corresponding row or column, and the integers themselves represents the number of consecutive black squares in corresponding group (you can find more detailed explanation in Wikipedia [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_crossword](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_crossword)).

Adaltik decided that the general case of japanese crossword is too complicated and drew a row consisting of $*n*$ squares (e.g. japanese crossword sized $1 × *n*$), which he wants to encrypt in the same way as in japanese crossword.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/24409f1ba174394574276be0879d56f4b455ece1.png) The example of encrypting of a single row of japanese crossword.

Help Adaltik find the numbers encrypting the row he drew.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the length of the row. The second line of the input contains a single string consisting of $*n*$ characters '`B`' or '`W`', ('`B`' corresponds to black square, '`W`' — to white square in the row that Adaltik drew).

## Output

The first line should contain a single integer $*k*$ — the number of integers encrypting the row, e.g. the number of groups of black squares in the row.

The second line should contain $*k*$ integers, encrypting the row, e.g. corresponding to sizes of groups of consecutive black squares in the order from left to right.

## Note

The last sample case correspond to the picture in the statement.
statementZhMd:
最近，Adaltik 发现了日本填字游戏。日本填字游戏是一幅由大小为 $*a* × *b*$ 的方格表表示的图，每个方格被涂成白色或黑色。在每行的左侧和每列的上方都有一些整数，用来表示对应的行或列。这些整数的数量表示对应行或列中黑色方格组的数量，而整数本身表示每组连续黑色方格的数量（你可以在 Wikipedia [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_crossword](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_crossword) 中找到更详细的解释）。

Adaltik 认为一般情况下的日本填字游戏太复杂了，于是画了一行由 $*n*$ 个方格组成的图（例如大小为 $1 × *n*$ 的日本填字游戏），他希望用与日本填字游戏相同的方式对其进行编码。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/24409f1ba174394574276be0879d56f4b455ece1.png) 日本填字游戏中对单行进行编码的示例。

请帮助 Adaltik 找出对他所画行进行编码的数字。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——这一行的长度。输入的第二行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个字符 '`B`' 或 '`W`' 组成的字符串（其中 '`B`' 表示 Adaltik 所画行中的黑色方格，'`W`' 表示白色方格）。

## 输出格式

第一行应包含一个整数 $*k*$——对这一行进行编码的整数个数，即这一行中黑色方格组的数量。

第二行应包含 $*k*$ 个整数，对这一行进行编码，即按照从左到右的顺序给出各连续黑色方格组的大小。
